title: Nyang Meulakee Teumpat Suci .
intro: Bak watèe malam nyang seungap, sidroe jiwa nyang seutia geutawök ubak Nyang Maha Rahmat lam bintéh-bintéh nyang suci nibak saboh teumpat nyang suci. Meuthon-thon iman dan saba nyang hana meugoyang karab geubri balasan ngon saboh mukjizat nyang teuma jiba keusukaan dan pusaka keunabian.
clues: Uroe ngon malam ulôn peuhabéh bakti lam teumpat suci, hana putôh-putôh lôn meudoá ubak Tuhan ulôn.
Lon ka tuha, dan peurumoh lon ka mandul, bah pih meunan lon hana tom gadoh harapan bak rahmat Allah.
Lon geubri sidroe aneuk agam, nan jih Yahya, nyang jeuet keu nabi dan lampu keubeunaran.
Lon keudroe sidroe nabi, geukirém keu geubimbing Bani Israel.
Ulôn keuturonan Nabi Harun dan ulôn meutugaih sibagoe teungku imeum ​​di Baét TUHAN.
Lon dipeucaya keu jaga Maryam, mak Isa, dan lon saksikan mukjizat-mukjizat gobnyan.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Dibri sidroe aneuk agam bak masa tuha .
Dipeuseulamat nibak apui nyang teungoh meu-ulang-ulang .
trial.answer: Dibri sidroe aneuk agam bak masa tuha .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Dikbulkan aneuk shaleh yang jeut keu nabi .
Geugisa bak bansa droë lheuëh geupeuseulamat nibak saboh eungkôt .
outcome.answer: Dikbulkan aneuk shaleh yang jeut keu nabi .

arabic: وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَإِلْيَاسَ ۖ كُلٌّۭ مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And Zechariah and John and Jesus and Elias - and all were of the righteous. (6:85)
